issues.title: Incorrect revenue calculation
issues.problem: Revenue should only include transactions with status 'COMPLETED', but the query includes all transactions where status is not 'FAILED'.
issues.fix: SUM(CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_REVENUE

issues.title: Missing filter for 'FAILED' transactions
issues.problem: The query does not calculate the failure rate as per the business rule.
issues.fix: No fix provided, additional query needed to calculate failure rate.

issues.title: Inconsistent naming convention
issues.problem: The query uses mixed case for column names which can lead to confusion and errors.
issues.fix: Use consistent casing, e.g., m.merchant_name, t.amount, t.status, m.merchant_id

review.corrected_sql: SELECT m.merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_txns FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions t JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE t.status!= 'FAILED' GROUP BY m.merchant_name;
review.summary: The query has a critical correctness issue with revenue calculation and lacks a failure rate calculation. Readability can be improved with consistent naming.
